KEN.note: Training is for youth, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Power Learn Project, ILO, Microsoft and the Garissa County Government, with Netherlands support, are implementing a 25-week digital skills programme for about 1,700 refugee and host-community youth in Garissa and Turkana, with over 700 enrolled.
